description.zh: 用途：需要简明结论的中文沟通。 不适用：必须完整展开推导或已约定详尽交付的任务。 这是可选择的行为偏好，不代表普遍最优做法。
description.en: Use: Chinese communication that needs concise conclusions. Not for: tasks that must spell out the full derivation or have agreed an exhaustive deliverable. This is a selectable behavior preference, not a universally best practice.

en: Chinese communication that needs concise conclusions.
